data.name: The alert window ends today
data.Statement: The alert reports the window of local days that ends today and starts the given number of days back, today included. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:330`

data.name: A rise is measured against the window just before
data.Statement: With the rise threshold the earlier window has the same length and ends the day before the current window starts. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:336`

data.name: An alert fires only above the threshold
data.Statement: The alert fires when the compared amount is strictly greater than the threshold; an equal amount sends nothing. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:282`

data.name: Schema migrations only run forward
data.Statement: Opening the store runs every migration after the stored schema version, in list order, and records the new version after each; there is no downgrade step. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:147`

data.name: Forgetting a session keeps its cost
data.impact: A forgotten session still counts in totals and its raw records stay in the store, while its routes answer 404
data.likelihood: high whenever a session is forgotten
data.Risk: Forgetting deletes only the session's spans and rating `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:597`, and ingest checks exclusions only for spans `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:273`, so its requests are kept and stored again.
data.Mitigation: Not found in the code. See the open question on forgetting requests.

data.name: Project exclusion and retention skip requests
data.impact: Requests of an excluded or expired project keep their project, working directory and raw record in the store and in reports
data.Risk: Requests are inserted without the exclusion test `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:270` and retention deletes only trace rows `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:302`.

data.name: Truncation runs before redaction
data.impact: A secret cut at the byte limit can fall below a pattern's minimum length and be returned unredacted
data.likelihood: low, and only when metadata only is off
data.Risk: Released text is truncated first and redacted after `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:97` `src/ai_usage_cost/privacy.py:98`.

data.name: A bad date option ends in a raw error
data.impact: A mistyped since or until value shows a Python error instead of a usage message
data.Risk: Dates are parsed with no guard `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:45`.

data.name: An invalid rate file stops every command
data.impact: One malformed rates.json row stops scan, serve, export, alert and tui with a validation error
data.likelihood: low for the bundled file, medium for a file passed with --rates
data.Risk: Loading validates the whole file with no handler `src/ai_usage_cost/pricing.py:287`.
data.Mitigation: The model validators reject duplicate keys and overlapping periods at load, so a bad file fails loudly rather than pricing quietly.

data.name: Should forgetting a session remove its requests
data.Question: Forgetting removes spans and the rating but keeps requests `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:595`. Should the session's cost and raw records also go, and should project exclusion apply to requests?
